# omadafusion_reboot_schedule (Resource)

Scheduled device reboots (Services > Reboot Schedule). Names must be unique.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_devices" "all" {}

# Reboot every AP early on the first of the month.
resource "omadafusion_reboot_schedule" "aps" {
  name         = "Monthly AP reboot"
  device_macs  = [for d in data.omadafusion_devices.all.devices : d.mac if d.type == "ap"]
  schedule     = "monthly"
  day_of_month = 1
  hour         = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_macs` (Set of String) MACs of adopted devices to reboot, in `AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF` form (as `omadafusion_devices` reports them).
- `hour` (Number) Hour, 0-23, site time zone.
- `name` (String) Schedule name. Must be unique.
- `schedule` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.

### Optional

- `day_of_month` (Number) For `monthly`: 1-31.
- `day_of_week` (Number) For `weekly`: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs.
- `minute` (Number) Minute, 0-59.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Schedule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_reboot_schedule.aps Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000014
```
